buildCommand: cd ../.. && mkdir -p .corepack && corepack enable --install-directory .corepack && PATH="$PWD/.corepack:$PATH" pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=wallet-dashboard --concurrency=1
installCommand: cd ../.. && mkdir -p .corepack && corepack enable --install-directory .corepack && PATH="$PWD/.corepack:$PATH" SCARF_ANALYTICS=false SENTRYCLI_SKIP_DOWNLOAD=1 PNPM_CONFIG_CHILD_CONCURRENCY=1 pnpm --filter=wallet-dashboard... install --frozen-lockfile
